Biomechanics & Motion Capture HPS400600 AMTI HPS400600 Force Plate The HPS400600 is part of AMTI's OPTIMA High Performance Series (HPS) - the most advanced, most accurate force platform system available. The 40×60 cm platform is ideal for accommodating average human stride lengths and can be used in pairs for bilateral jump or balance assessments. Multiple plates can be combined to create full instrumented floor systems. Read More

Biomechanics & Motion Capture ACG-O AMTI AccuGait-O Force Plate The AccuGait-Optimized (ACG-O) is AMTI's portable force platform for quantifying human gait and balance. Its patented design is accurate, economical, and easy to use on any flat surface - no mounting required. A single USB cable handles both data and power. Pair with the AccuGait Walkway to build a complete mobile gait lab. Read More

Biomechanics & Motion Capture BMS400600 AMTI BMS400600 Force Plate The BMS400600 is AMTI's most popular mountable force plate. As part of the OPTIMA Biomechanics Measurement Series, it offers superior accuracy, high natural frequency, and versatility across gait, balance, and sports applications in the most affordable package. Available in Standard and High Frequency models with three capacity options. Read More
